preserve: Declared route families choose their existing mounted operation. Unmatched methods and paths do not invent an owner or a result.
The adapter preserves method, path, body and repeated query values in the family request. The supplied domain executor selects the resource and rechecks current account authority.
The native HTTP answer retains status, headers and body. Browser changes from another origin are refused before execution; the origin guard permits reads.
A carried original request key remains the command key. Routing neither replays a mutation nor manufactures an original result.
allowed_deltas: Rust consumes current owner-routes and tool-routes DATA and invokes the mounted DomainExecutor instead of constructing a JavaScript Request for a Worker handler. No edge-host owner, JavaScript issuer or retired Worker fallback is retained.

The existing response conversion is crate-visible so the MCP browser-session consumer reuses the same HTTP/JSON conversion. The route DATA path was renamed from server/workshop-routes.json to server/tool-routes.json; no second table or decoder is introduced.

The adapter bounds route input, answers transport-only HEAD with an empty body and adds no-store. Native refusal path diagnostics now render only matching literals from the existing compiled route DATA, mask an entire request suffix and use a closed unresolved word when no literal matches. Lexical bounds alone were insufficient because a lowercase identifier could become a log word. The cached literal projection has no editable route state or separate routing authority; this diagnostic boundary is new native behavior, not claimed JavaScript parity.

The old origin helper permits changes when browser headers are absent. Rust's invoke additionally requires a matching Origin for every effective non-GET method, including OPTIONS; HEAD becomes GET. This stricter browser entry is not absent-header parity.

This retrospective behavioral contract covers route translation, browser guards and response conversion. It does not claim a source-first copy or full historical Worker, startup, installed-app or customer parity.
banned_substitutions: A second editable route table or response serializer maintained by a consumer.
Treating a resource identifier or request key as authority, or restoring the retired Worker or JavaScript issuer.
Calling fixture executor tests proof of real account authority, public deployment or unknown-write recovery.

baseline.source_state: Metadata prepared after implementation. The immutable retired sources establish the stated behaviors; no historical byte-copy baseline is asserted. The cited old paths are absent at the source repository's published origin/main ed5e8d0389729321ca4263294b6a377235829e5e.

proof.qualification: The diagnostic correction passed all seven workspace refusal tests with no failures or ignored tests on frozen tree fda3bfcb6494fcffab75307b3522c33cc633380f through the normal focused candidate owner, worker exit 0 and process group stopped. That tree includes the genuine f02c41e3a signup correction and only this owned workspace source edit; target blob 7c410e0dacc0144fda653e467c3f68a2fed496f3 matches disk. Read-only independent dataflow review checked both report_unadmitted callers and invoke; its doc/per-request parsing findings were corrected by the compiled-literal cache. A broader frozen integration run exposed a fixture that omitted the Host required by the existing page policy: it correctly answered 400 before reaching the absent page owner. The corrected fixture preserves that refusal and supplies its declared loopback Host to reach the expected 503. Frozen coupled tree 0eb9b0aebf108863cf7899d67d2b67f02506d68e then passed all eight ordinary workspace integration tests, no failures or ignored tests; the existing external-frontend fixture was filtered out, not executed. No ignore or environment waiver changed. Existing test formatting was verified to be exactly rustfmt of its committed version before this fixture correction and is retained. These are named source checks, not installation, customer behavior or full-chain publication.

One test failed, none passed or were ignored; worker exit 101 and process group stopped. Primary source was not changed for this opponent.
